items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1969-12-14
items.q: But there were so many great trumpet players, like Red Borman, that was another great trumpet man.

ctx.x: Yeah, the man who never recorded, Eddie.

He never did record, no, because he didn't have the chance. But there were so many great trumpet players, like Red Borman, that was another great trumpet man. And it takes quite a few. In fact, I mean, we have still some fine jazz men, but they just don't get together. And when they don't get together, what they do, they organize the band, and they'll organize to their satisfaction. They get a drum player that don't know the beats, and then they call themselves.
